answer: Cosignatures are collected in atlas, verified in saffron, and haven names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 24 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 11 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
